deeplink.encryptedHapp: This is an encrypted Happ subscription ({{variant}}). VPNTE cannot decrypt it — ask your provider for a regular subscription URL (https://…) or a vless:// link.
deeplink.encryptedMantaray: This is an encrypted MantaRay subscription (mantaray://{{variant}}/...). VPNTE cannot decrypt it without the MantaRay app's keys. Ask your provider for a regular subscription URL (https://...) or a direct key link (vless://, trojan://, ss://, vmess://, hysteria2://, naive://, anytls://, shadowtls://, tuic://).
deeplink.encrypted: This is an encrypted {{app}} link ({{variant}}). VPNTE cannot decrypt it — ask your provider for a regular subscription URL (https://…) or a protocol key (vless://, trojan://, ss://, vmess://, hysteria2://, naive://, anytls://, shadowtls://, tuic://).
deeplink.routingProfile: This is a Happ routing rule (happ://routing/…), not a VPN subscription. Paste a subscription link or a protocol key (vless://, trojan://, ss://, vmess://, hysteria2://, naive://, anytls://, shadowtls://, tuic://).
deeplink.addPayloadUnrecognised: Could not read the app link (happ://add/…, mantaray://…): it should contain a subscription URL or a protocol key (vless://…), but the content looks like neither.
deeplink.unknownHost: Unknown link type {{link}}/. Paste a regular subscription link (https://…) or a protocol key (vless://, trojan://, ss://, vmess://, hysteria2://, naive://, anytls://, shadowtls://, tuic://).
deeplink.localTarget: This link points into a local network, so the app does not open it. If the subscription is yours, paste its address directly.

xrayNative.invalidProfile: The saved Xray profile is damaged. Import the provider's configuration again.
xrayNative.missingSelected: The saved Xray profile has no main server. Import the provider's configuration again.
xrayNative.duplicateTag: Servers in the Xray configuration have missing or repeated tags.
xrayNative.badBalancerTag: A balancer in the Xray configuration has a missing or repeated tag.
xrayNative.missingBalancer: A route in the Xray configuration points to a balancer that does not exist.
xrayNative.emptyBalancer: A balancer in the Xray configuration selects no servers.
xrayNative.missingDependency: The Xray configuration points to a server that does not exist (dialerProxy, fallbackTag or a route).
xrayNative.applicationBypass: The Xray configuration can send application traffic directly, bypassing the VPN; such a route is not accepted.
xrayNative.cyclic: Servers in the Xray configuration refer to each other in a loop.
xrayNative.missingLoopbackRoute: A loopback server in the Xray configuration has no route.
xrayNative.loopbackRouteNoDestination: A loopback route in the Xray configuration does not say where to send traffic.
xrayNative.unsupportedProtocol: The Xray configuration uses a protocol that is not supported in a chain.
xrayNative.noEntry: The Xray configuration does not say where traffic enters.
xrayNative.selectedOutsideGraph: The main server of the Xray configuration is not part of its route.
xrayNative.localFileReference: The Xray configuration refers to a local file (certificate, key or TLS key log); such subscriptions are not accepted.
xrayNative.multipleEndpoints: A server in the Xray configuration must list exactly one server and one user; Xray refuses anything else.
xrayNative.insecureWithoutPin: The Xray configuration turns off certificate checks (allowInsecure) without pinnedPeerCertSha256; Xray refuses to run it.
xrayNative.reservedTag: The Xray configuration uses the reserved tag vpnte-block.
xrayNative.tooDeep: The chain of servers in the Xray configuration is too long.
xrayNative.geoData: The Xray configuration routes by geo data (geoip, geosite or an ext: file) that the app does not ship; Xray could not start it.
xrayNative.removedTransport: The Xray configuration uses the HTTP/2 or QUIC transport, which Xray 26 removed; Xray could not start it.
